perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Taken Divergence
perks.desc: This weapon resonates with your choices.

perks.name: Taken Resolution
perks.desc: Hitting three different targets generates a large amount of blight. Blighted Seekers bore through targets.

perks.name: Taken Ambition
perks.desc: Blight generated increases the longer this weapon remains on a target. Blighted Seekers burrow into targets and explode.

perks.name: Textured Grip
perks.desc:
The friction on this weapon's grip is particularly strong.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Smooth Grip
perks.desc:
This weapon is slightly easier to hold and aim.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Polymer Grip
perks.desc:
This weapon's grip is made of lighter material.
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Heavy Grip
perks.desc:
This grip is weighted for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Decreases handling speed

perks.name: Combat Grip
perks.desc:
This weapon's recoil direction is more vertical.
  •  Greatly controls recoil

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves Refit
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Hatchling Refit
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: One for All Refit
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Target Lock Refit
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.
